title: Refresh and Research again on /ops name the operator through the host's principalOf and work on a database without Tracy's account table
steps: S1: On a database migrated by the package only (no account table), call refreshPlace and researchAgainPlace with an actor and a principalOf that names a wo_principal.
S2: Call refreshPlace for an operator the host does not know.
S3: Tracy's research usage test: an /ops refresh is paid by the operator's account.
expect: S1: both queue a run with started_by = operator and started_by_account_id = the named principal.
evidence: Before the fix both looked up 'select id from account where lower(email) = ...' and failed with relation "account" does not exist
fence: operatorPrincipal in wo-places-store.js goes through host.principalOf; Tracy passes wo-host.js principalOf

tests: Refresh pressed on /ops is paid by the operator the host names
Research again pressed on /ops is paid by the operator the host names
an operator the host does not know is recorded without a principal
